resources.string: Catches remote buttons you choose, stops their normal action, and runs your own action for a single press, double press or hold: a webhook, navigation, a media key, or opening an app.
Press the button on your remote now…
Button name, e.g. Netflix or Mic
LineageOS takes this button\'s release, so it has no hold, only single and double press.
Headers (every gesture of this button, one per line)

A hooked button never does its normal action. Set every gesture to Nothing (or leave them empty) to just disable it. Navigation, media keys and Open app run on the Shield; Webhook sends an HTTP request, where {gesture} and {key} in the URL or body are replaced with the gesture and keycode, and a body starting with { or [ is sent as JSON unless a Content-Type header says otherwise. The name is what the on-screen badge shows. If double press does nothing, single presses fire immediately.
TV power: follows the Shield (on/off codes)
TV power: follows the Shield (toggle code)
Fires from: the remote you pressed
%1$s TV off: only with the power button
%1$s TV off: whenever the Shield sleeps

\"Only with the power button\" is greyed out because Button Hooks can\'t yet tell why the Shield fell asleep. Until it can, the TV stays on when the Shield sleeps (waking still turns it on). To allow it, run this once from a computer:\nadb shell pm grant com.barrettcoats.buttonhooks android.permission.DUMP

This also turns the TV off when the Shield\'s sleep timer runs out, and when HDMI-CEC puts the Shield to sleep because a console or other device took over the TV, even in the middle of a game or film.
Selected, but it needs the adb grant first: see the note below

Uses the TV power codes stored on the Shield Remote (set up on NVIDIA\'s firmware): waking the Shield turns the TV on, and \"TV off\" picks when sleeping turns it off. If your remote only has a toggle code, use the toggle setting; if the TV then gets out of step, fix it once with the TV\'s own button. With two remotes paired, it fires from the one whose button slept or woke the Shield; or pick one to always use.
